question: 查询2026年1月1日至2026年7月21日罗湖区每日的网供电量和地方电厂电量，按日期和供电类型分组

data.sql:
select f."ptdate" as "ptdate", f."elec_supply_type" as "elec_supply_type", f."gdj" as "gdj", sum(f."electricityvalue") as "electricityvalue" from (select mainsrc."data_time" as "ptdate", mainsrc."electricitytype" as "elec_supply_type", mainsrc."org_name" as "gdj", mainsrc."electricityvalue" as "electricityvalue" from (with
-- 1) 按天序列：仅用于分组遍历，绝不参与分区大表扫描条件
day_series as (
    select generate_series(
        '2026-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp,
        '2026-07-21 00:00:00'::timestamp,
        interval '1day'
    ) as d                                                                              -- 遍历日 d
),
-- 2) 分区大表裁剪：右侧全为占位符字面量，裸列 data_time 触发静态分区裁剪(Static Prune)
--    半开区间 [start, end+1day)，一次性只扫命中分区
pq_raw as (
    select
        pq.obj_detail_id,                                                               -- 关联键
        pq.data_time,                                                                   -- 真实业务时间戳
        pq.ap_total                                                                     -- 电量
    from hydwsdb.mk_mc_anal_obj_day_pq as pq
    where pq.data_time >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp
      and pq.data_time <  '2026-07-21 00:00:00'::timestamp + interval '1day'
),
-- 3) 维度表：非时间参数 supply_org_no 的过滤条件已删除，但作为展示维度保留输出
--    其余硬编码常量原样保留
obj as (
    select
        a.obj_detail_id,                                                                -- 关联键
        a.sort_code,                                                                    -- 分类编码
        a.supply_org_no                                                                 -- 供电单位编码(展示维度)
    from ams_app.mk_mc_analysis_obj_view as a
    where a.sort_code in ('3','2')                       -- 硬编码常量，保留
      and a.associated_file_type = '1'                  -- 硬编码常量，保留
      and a.obj_type_code = '1'                          -- 硬编码常量，保留
),
-- 4) 按天 × supply_org_no × sort_code 聚合当日电量
power_rs as (
    select
        ds.d                             as d,                                          -- 遍历日
        o.supply_org_no                  as supply_org_no,                              -- 供电单位编码
        o.sort_code                      as sort_code,                                  -- 分类编码
        sum(pr.ap_total)                 as power                                       -- 当日电量
    from day_series ds
    left join obj    o  on 1=1
    left join pq_raw pr on pr.obj_detail_id = o.obj_detail_id
                       and pr.data_time     = ds.d                                      -- 当天归属：精确到天
    group by ds.d, o.supply_org_no, o.sort_code
)
select
    to_char(prs.d,'YYYY-MM-DD')                            as data_time,                -- 真实业务日期(该行属于哪一天)
    prs.supply_org_no                                      as supply_org_no,            -- 供电单位编码(展示维度)
    org.org_name                                          as org_name,                 -- 供电单位名称(展示维度)
    case when prs.sort_code = '3' then '地方电厂电量（含光伏）'
         when prs.sort_code = '2' then '网供电量' end       as electricityType,          -- 电量类型
    coalesce(to_char(prs.power/10000,'FM9999999999999999990.00'),'0.00') as electricityValue  -- 电量值(万kWh)
from power_rs prs
left join ams_app.mk_mc_sys_org_levels org
       on org.org_no = prs.supply_org_no                                                -- 通过供电单位编码关联组织名称
order by prs.d, prs.supply_org_no, to_number(coalesce(to_char(prs.power/10000,'FM9999999999999999990.00'),'0.00')) desc) mainsrc) f where 1=1 and f.`elec_supply_type` in ('地方电厂电量（含光伏）', '网供电量') and f.`gdj` in ('罗湖供电局', '罗湖局') and f.`ptdate` >= '2026-01-01' and f.`ptdate` <= '2026-07-21' group by f."ptdate", f."elec_supply_type", f."gdj" ORDER BY "ptdate" ASC
limit
  1000 offset 0
